title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature T must be correctly calculated as approximately 6 x 10^9 K.

title: Photon Density Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the photon density equation for black body radiation.

title: Power Equation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between power, number of photons, and energy must be correctly established.

title: Correct Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct physical constants such as h, c, and k in their calculations.

title: Logarithmic Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The logarithmic function in the temperature calculation should be correctly evaluated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the equations.

title: Divergence Angle Relevance
description: Optional Criteria: The relevance of the divergence angle in the context of the problem should be discussed.
